t: What Does The Name Jiaru Mean?
s: In these forms, Jia (佳/嘉) conveys “excellent,” “auspicious,” or “praiseworthy,” while Ru (如) means “as,” “like,” or “according to,” yielding readings such as “as excellent (as hoped)” or “praiseworthy as intended.” Because Chinese names are character-dependent, Jiaru can also be written with other hanzi-e.g., 家如 (“family/household as [wished]”) or 佳儒 (“excellent scholar”)-shifting the nuance while keeping a similar sound.
